body.zh-Hant: 霍爾蒂1868年生於新教貴族家庭，早年在奧匈帝國海軍服役，升遷很快。第一次世界大戰期間，他大部分時間擔任「諾瓦拉」號與「歐根親王」號的艦長，1918年被任命為海軍中將並出任艦隊司令。
body.en: Horthy was born in 1868 into a noble Protestant family and served in the Austro-Hungarian navy, rising quickly. For most of the First World War he captained the Novara and the Prinz Eugen, and in 1918 he was made vice admiral and commander of the fleet.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年5月，霍爾蒂被拉進反革命內閣，出任陸軍（戰爭）部長，並在塞格德擔任小規模國民軍的總司令。國民軍發動的「白色恐怖」造成約一千至五千人死亡。蘇維埃共和國被羅馬尼亞軍隊擊潰後，他讓自己被選為匈牙利攝政。
body.en: In May 1919 Horthy was drawn into the counterrevolutionary cabinet as Minister of War and became commander-in-chief of the small National Army in Szeged. The White Terror begun by that army claimed between one thousand and five thousand lives. After the Republic of Soviets was crushed by the Romanian Army, he had himself elected Regent of Hungary.

body.zh-Hant: 霍爾蒂在兩戰之間長期受保守派首相貝特倫（1921至1931年任職）影響，但和當時匈牙利政治人物一樣，一心收復戰後失去的領土，因此愈來愈靠近希特勒。慕尼黑協定後，南斯洛伐克部分地區歸還匈牙利；1941年6月匈牙利對蘇聯參戰。
body.en: Through the interwar years Horthy stayed under the influence of the conservative prime minister István Bethlen (1921–1931), but like other Hungarian statesmen he sought to regain lost territory, which drew him toward Hitler. After the Munich agreement parts of southern Slovakia were returned to Hungary, and in June 1941 Hungary entered the war against the Soviet Union.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年希特勒要求撤換首相卡洛伊後，霍爾蒂被迫任命親納粹政府，並同意驅逐匈牙利大部分猶太人，但拒絕同意驅逐布達佩斯的猶太人。10月15日他宣布退出戰爭，隨即被德國人逮捕，箭十字黨領袖取而代之。戰後他流亡葡萄牙，1957年在當地去世。
body.en: In 1944, when Hitler demanded the removal of Prime Minister Kállay, Horthy was forced to appoint a pro-Nazi government and agreed to the deportation of most of Hungary's Jews, but refused consent for the Jews of Budapest. On 15 October he announced Hungary's withdrawal from the war; the Germans arrested him and installed the Arrow Cross leader in his place. He spent most of his remaining life in exile in Portugal, where he died in 1957.

body.zh-Hant: 查希爾是穆罕默德·納迪爾·沙阿之子，1914年10月15日生於喀布爾，曾在喀布爾及法國的中學受教育。1932年任國防部副部長，次年任教育部長。1933年11月8日父親遇刺後，他在剛滿19歲時被王室迅速擁立為王，採用「託庇於真主、遵循伊斯蘭堅定信仰者」的稱號。
body.en: Zahir was the son of Mohammad Nadir Shah and was born in Kabul on 15 October 1914; he studied at schools in Kabul and in France. He became deputy defence minister in 1932 and education minister the next year. After his father was killed on 8 November 1933, the royal family quickly proclaimed him king at nineteen, and he took the title Al-Mutawakkil Ala'llah.

body.zh-Hant: 即位後約二十年，查希爾受父系叔父們監護：穆罕默德·哈希姆汗任首相，1946年5月起由沙·馬哈茂德汗接任。1940年8月17日他宣布阿富汗在第二次世界大戰中保持中立，並驅逐沒有外交身分的軸心國人員。
body.en: In the first twenty years of his reign Zahir was under the tutelage of his paternal uncles: Mohammad Hashim Khan as prime minister, followed from May 1946 by Shah Mahmud Khan. On 17 August 1940 he proclaimed Afghanistan's neutrality in the Second World War and expelled Axis subjects without diplomatic credentials.

body.zh-Hant: 禮薩出身相當貧困的家庭，父親在他約六個月大時去世。他15歲加入俄國訓練的哥薩克旅，1912年升到相當於上尉的軍階，1918年升為准將。
body.en: Reza was born to a rather poor family and his father died when he was about six months old. At fifteen he joined the Russian-trained Cossack Brigade, reached a rank equivalent to captain in 1912 and became a brigadier general in 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 1921年他領導一場由英國策劃的政變並佔領德黑蘭，不久出任戰爭部長；三年後（1924年）成為首相。1925年國會宣布他為伊朗沙阿，他選用前伊斯蘭時期的姓氏「巴勒維」。
body.en: In 1921 he headed a British-orchestrated coup and occupied Tehran, and soon became war minister; three years later, in 1924, he became prime minister. In 1925 the Majles proclaimed him shah of Iran, and he chose the pre-Islamic family name Pahlavi.

body.en: At the end of August 1941 Russia and England occupied Iran; in September he lost his throne and was exiled to South Africa, replaced by his 22-year-old son. He died in exile in Johannesburg.

body.zh-Hant: 迪亞斯1830年9月15日生於瓦哈卡市，是一位普通旅店主人的第六個孩子，父親在他三歲前去世。15歲進神學院，拒絕受聖職後改學法律，1853年通過民法與教會法的第一次考試。
body.en: Díaz was born on 15 September 1830 in the city of Oaxaca, the sixth child of a modest innkeeper; his father died before he turned three. He entered the seminary at fifteen, refused ordination and studied law instead, passing his first civil and canon law examination in 1853.

body.zh-Hant: 阿尤特拉計畫（1854）成功後，他出任伊斯特蘭副省長，政治生涯由此開始；1861年8月升准將，同年當選國會議員，任期很短。1862年5月5日他在普埃布拉擊退法軍而成名。後來他兩度起兵反對總統：因胡亞雷斯再度連任而發動諾里亞計畫，1876年1月再反對萊爾多，提出圖斯特佩克計畫。
body.en: After the triumph of the Plan of Ayutla (1854) he became subprefect of Ixtlán, the start of his political career; he was made brigadier general in August 1861 and elected to Congress that year, serving only briefly. He won fame at Puebla against the French on 5 May 1862. He later rebelled twice: against Juárez's reelection (Plan of la Noria) and in January 1876 against Lerdo (Plan of Tuxtepec).

body.zh-Hant: 迪亞斯1877年5月5日就任總統，第一任期末遵守諾言未再參選，改任發展部長並擔任瓦哈卡州長；1884年再度當選，其後於1888、1892、1904、1910年放棄反對連任的立場。他維持穩定、平衡預算並促進成長，但使墨西哥更依賴外資，權力趨於獨裁，阻止對手當選並箝制新聞。
body.en: Díaz took formal possession of the presidency on 5 May 1877. After his first term he did not run again, serving as secretary of development and governor of Oaxaca; he was elected again in 1884 and dropped his opposition to reelection in 1888, 1892, 1904 and 1910. He provided stable government and growth but increased reliance on foreign capital; his power became dictatorial and he prevented the election of opponents and muzzled the press.

body.zh-Hant: 1900年後，經濟蕭條、政治動員、民族主義升高與總統年事已高，使他維繫派系平衡的體系開始瓦解。1908年他在對美國記者克里爾曼的訪談中似乎宣布墨西哥已準備好競爭性選舉、他不會在1910年再度參選，後來他改變主意。1911年5月21日其代表與馬德羅簽署華雷斯城條約，他於5月25日辭去總統職位，月底前往巴黎流亡並在當地去世。
body.en: After 1900 the system began to fall apart under depression, political organization, nationalism and the president's age. In 1908 he seemed, in an interview with the reporter James Creelman, to announce that Mexico was ready for competitive elections and that he would not run in 1910, but later changed his mind. His representative signed the Treaty of Ciudad Juárez with Madero on 21 May 1911; Díaz resigned on 25 May and went into exile in Paris, where he died.

body.zh-Hant: 蘇慕薩1896年2月1日出生，曾在費城上學，英語流利。1927至1933年美軍占領尼加拉瓜期間，他受到美國國務卿史汀生注意；美國讓他指揮新成立的國民警衛隊。他娶了自由黨總統薩卡薩的外甥女。
body.en: Somoza was born on 1 February 1896 and went to school in Philadelphia, gaining excellent English. During the 1927–1933 US occupation he came to the attention of Secretary of State Stimson, and the United States gave him command of the newly created National Guard. He married Salvadora Debayle, niece of President Juan Bautista Sacasa.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年薩卡薩與游擊領袖桑地諾談成和平後，蘇慕薩安排殺害桑地諾。他以國民警衛隊為權力基礎，1936年逼迫薩卡薩下台，並於同年12月「當選」總統，儘管法律上他因與薩卡薩有親戚關係且是警衛隊司令而受限。
body.en: In 1934, after Sacasa had completed peace negotiations with the guerrilla commander Sandino, Somoza arranged Sandino's murder. Using the Guard as a base he ousted Sacasa in 1936 and was 'elected' president in December 1936, despite legal barriers as Sacasa's relative and Guard commander.

body.zh-Hant: 擔任總統期間他仍掌握國民警衛隊最高指揮權，並把民族自由黨重建為個人政治機器。他在二戰期間趁機擴張私人財產，以對抗納粹為由沒收德、意僑民財產，到1944年已是全國最大私人地主與主要糖產者。1944年他頒布新勞工法典。
body.en: As president he kept supreme command of the National Guard and rebuilt the Nationalist Liberal Party as a personal machine. Using World War II he expanded his holdings, confiscating German and Italian-owned properties on the pretext of combating Nazism; by 1944 he was the largest private landowner and leading sugar producer. He enacted a new labor code in 1944.
